description: Total collection value in `currency` (default USD), plus gain/loss versus recorded purchase prices (converted through ECB rates). include_proxies defaults to FALSE — proxies are excluded from value everywhere unless explicitly requested; say so when reporting. top_movers:true adds the biggest 7-day price movers among owned cards (needs nightly snapshots). The value over time is price_history.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name: collection_value

fx_date.description: The day of the ECB rates used

include_proxies.description: false: proxies are left out of every figure; say so

purchase_known.description: Gain or loss over the copies with a recorded purchase price only

top_movers.description: The biggest 7-day movers among owned cards, when asked

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

unpriced_cards.description: Copies with no price, left out of total_value

title: Collection value
